flows.representativeInput: Git fixture: feature docs/features/x with spec 1 done (legacy owner acceptance) and spec 2 in-review; archive --phase session-end --apply, then with --as-is --owner-instruction "<text>" --apply
flows.expected: Default exits 1 with "Spec 2 is not accepted" and leaves the folder; the flagged run exits 0, moves the folder to docs/archive/x/feature and reports unverified: docs/archive/x/unverified.md

observations.actual: Test [AC:spec-8-1] passed (7/7 in the file): default run exit 1, stderr exactly "Archive stopped: Spec 2 is not accepted", source still present; --as-is run exit 0, empty stderr, output has status archived, unverified path, currentAcceptanceRenewed false, archivedAsIs true; source gone, 02-b.md under the archive. Source review: the non-as-is loop is byte-for-byte the old path (archive.mjs:408), so the default refusal is unchanged.

Reviewer probes P1 and P4: an --as-is preview without --apply exits 0 and writes nothing; --owner-instruction without --as-is is refused ("only for --as-is") and the default run still refuses with the folder in place.

flows.representativeInput: Same fixture; spec 2 report outside the folder names a receipt docs/reviews/x/gone.txt that does not exist; a second variant marks spec 2 done with acceptedReport; probe fixture keeps a report inside the feature folder and uses a two-line instruction
flows.expected: unverified.md names spec 2, the missing receipt (when an acceptance record names it) and the instruction verbatim; archived queue bytes equal the source queue; reports unchanged; manifest evidence holds only real acceptances

observations.actual: Tests [AC:spec-8-2] passed: note has "- Spec 2 (`02-b.md`): status in-review", not spec 1, "> <instruction>" and the disclaimer; archived queue and spec bytes equal the source bytes; outside report unchanged; manifest evidence kinds = [legacy-acceptance]; repeat is idempotent. Second test: done spec with acceptedReport lists "Missing or changed: `docs/reviews/x/gone.txt`".

Reviewer probe P2: a report inside the feature folder is byte-identical after the as-is move; a two-line instruction with markdown is kept verbatim in archive-replay.json asIs.ownerInstruction and quoted line by line in unverified.md; manifest evidence is [] when no spec is accepted; currentAcceptanceRenewed false. P6: editing unverified.md after archive makes the repeat refuse ("Archived as-is note is missing or changed").

limits: Missing receipts are found only through acceptance records in the queue (acceptedReport, ownerAcceptance, waiver); see finding f2.

flows.representativeInput: archive ... --as-is --apply without --owner-instruction; also --apply --as-is order and a whitespace-only value
flows.expected: Non-zero exit with a message naming --owner-instruction; folder not moved

observations.actual: Test [AC:spec-8-3] passed: exit non-zero, stderr contains --owner-instruction, source still present. review-b-9 also passed: a value starting with -- is refused.
Reviewer probes P3 and P5: flag order --apply --as-is gives exit 1 "Archive --as-is needs --owner-instruction ..."; a whitespace-only value is refused with exit 1 and the folder stays.

findings.summary: tests/runtime-archive-as-is.test.ts is not a declared verification input, so startup trace showed spec-8-1/2/3 untraced. The file tags them at lines 45, 58, 78 and 91. The reviewer used it as a check input; the queue was not edited.

missingReceipts follows only reports named by queue acceptance records. An in-review spec with a report whose receipt is gone (the test fixture's spec 2) is listed by status, but its missing receipt is not listed, because no queue record names that report.
findings.assumption: "Each missing receipt" means receipts that the spec's acceptance records name; the spec test checks the done-with-acceptedReport case.

findings.summary: A whitespace-only --owner-instruction is refused, but with the generic "Invalid or duplicate argument: --owner-instruction" rather than a message that asks for the owner's words.
The repo's installed .joycraft/runtime/archive.mjs and .joycraft/references/archive.md differ from payload/; payload/PIN matches payload/ (spec-08-pin.log). Left to the release/install flow.
